item.tib: khro bo spyi 'dul gyis drag po gtor bzlog
item.coloph: spyi 'dul gyi drag zlog ting sing rom po dpal ri'i rdza la yod/ bse sgrom smug po'i nang nas bton/ spyi 'dul drag bzlog (zlog) yi ger bkod pa 'di la lhag chad nor 'khrul ci mchis thams cad/ yi dam lha srung mkha' 'gro dpal mgon dang / gter bdag dregs pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol//
